product.title: Yosemite Highlights Small Group Tour

description.text: Explore Yosemite Valley on a small-group guided tour with a naturalist guide who shares park history, geology, and wildlife stories. Photo stops include Tunnel View, Bridalveil Fall, and El Capitan Meadow with time to walk short trails near Yosemite Falls.

highlights: Tunnel View overlook of Yosemite Valley
Photo stops at Bridalveil Fall and El Capitan Meadow
Guided commentary on park geology and wildlife
Round-trip transport from select meeting points

start.description: Meet at the designated Yosemite area pickup point. Arrive 15 minutes before departure for check-in with your naturalist guide.

end.description: Return to the original meeting point after the valley highlights loop.

product.itinerarySummary: Explore Yosemite Valley on a small-group guided tour with a naturalist guide who shares park history, geology, and wildlife stories.

itineraryItems.title: Tunnel View
itineraryItems.description: Stop at the classic overlook for panoramic views of El Capitan, Half Dome, and Bridalveil Fall.

itineraryItems.title: Bridalveil Fall
itineraryItems.description: Walk to the base of Bridalveil Fall for misty views of the 620-foot cascade.

itineraryItems.title: El Capitan Meadow
itineraryItems.description: Photo stop beneath the granite walls of El Capitan with guide commentary.

itineraryItems.title: Yosemite Valley
itineraryItems.description: Scenic drive through the valley floor with views of Cathedral Rocks and Sentinel Rock.

itineraryItems.title: Yosemite Falls
itineraryItems.description: Stop near Lower Yosemite Fall for a short walk and waterfall views.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.answer: Meet at the designated Yosemite area pickup point. Arrive 15 minutes before departure for check-in with your naturalist guide.
